description: This file defines the {@link PolicyCreated} event class, which represents an event emitted after a policy has been created in the system. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, accessing the associated policy, and serializing to JSON.

classes.name: PolicyCreated
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the creation of a policy. It includes fields for the policy object, methods for creating instances, serialization/deserialization, and overrides for equality and string representation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyCreated event with specified policy, revision, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyCreated event from a JSON string or object and headers.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the policy associated with this event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the given DittoHeaders.
